# VisionzLab

> AI studio helping small and mid-sized businesses in Canada and the US put AI agents to work: training, guided agent setup, custom AI development, managed AI employees, and AI engineering capacity instead of a new hire. Also an AI-assisted security review for small businesses.

VisionzLab (also written Visionz Lab, VisionZ Lab) is based in Ontario, Canada, and serves Canada and the United States.

Who we serve: Businesses from owner-run firms up to about 1,000 people, usually without an in-house AI team, across Canada and the United States. We're based in Ontario and work online or on site.

Pricing: The first discovery session is free. The Discovery Sprint is a fixed fee agreed before it starts. Builds are fixed-price for a fixed scope; managed AI employees and AI teams are monthly. We don't publish rates: we quote a defined first step after the discovery session.

- [AI Agent Training for Small Businesses](https://visionzlab.com/services/ai-training/): Hands-on workshops and coaching that teach your team to set up and run their own AI agents and automations with tools you already pay for.
- [AI Agent Setup Service](https://visionzlab.com/services/ai-agent-setup/): We set up your first AI agent with your team, connect it to your tools, and hand it over with a playbook so you can run it yourselves.
- [Custom AI Agent Development](https://visionzlab.com/services/ai-development/): Fixed-scope, fixed-price development of production AI agents and automations, built to your requirements and handed over to your team.
- [Always-On AI Employee for Your Business](https://visionzlab.com/services/ai-employee/): An always-on AI employee for one defined role, working from a company brain you own. We build it and keep it working for a monthly fee.
- [An AI Engineering Team Instead of a New Hire](https://visionzlab.com/services/ai-team/): Before you hire a software or AI engineer, consider senior AI engineering capacity on retainer, building what the role would build with an AI-first stack.
- [AI-Assisted Security Review for Small Businesses](https://visionzlab.com/services/security-review/): A fixed-scope security review for small businesses: AI-assisted scans and settings checks, a plain-English fix list, and help closing the gaps that matter.
- [AI Agent Use Cases](https://visionzlab.com/use-cases/): Agents for operations, growth and finance teams.
- [AI Quote and RFQ Intake Agent](https://visionzlab.com/use-cases/quote-rfq-intake/): An AI agent that reads incoming requests for quote, matches items to your catalogue and pricing, and drafts the quote for your team to approve.
- [AI Order Entry and Exceptions Agent](https://visionzlab.com/use-cases/order-entry/): An AI agent that turns emailed and PDF purchase orders into entered orders, checks them against price, stock and terms, and flags exceptions for your team.
- [AI Document Intake and Data Extraction Agent](https://visionzlab.com/use-cases/document-intake/): An AI agent that reads invoices, applications, shipping documents and forms, extracts the data your systems need, and checks it before anyone re-keys it.
- [AI Shared Inbox Triage and Reply Drafting Agent](https://visionzlab.com/use-cases/inbox-triage/): An AI agent that sorts a shared inbox, routes each message to the right person and drafts replies for review, with routing rules agreed with your team.
- [AI Renewal Tracking and Client Follow-up Agent](https://visionzlab.com/use-cases/renewals-follow-up/): An AI agent that tracks renewal and maturity dates, prepares timely outreach and follows up with leads and clients, so no renewal or enquiry slips.
- [AI Market Intelligence Agent](https://visionzlab.com/use-cases/market-intelligence/): An AI agent that tracks competitors, pricing, news and market signals and delivers a weekly brief your leadership team can act on.
- [AI Prospect Research and Account Planning Agent](https://visionzlab.com/use-cases/prospect-research/): An AI agent that researches target accounts, maps buying teams and drafts account plans, so your business development team spends its time selling.
- [AI Planning and OKR Assistant](https://visionzlab.com/use-cases/planning-okrs/): An AI assistant that turns leadership goals into tracked objectives and key results, collects progress from your tools, and writes the monthly update.
- [AI Financial Reporting Agent](https://visionzlab.com/use-cases/financial-reporting/): An AI agent that pulls numbers from your accounting and business systems, prepares monthly reports and drafts variance commentary for review.
- [AI Quote & Order Automation for Distributors](https://visionzlab.com/for/distributors-manufacturers/): AI agents that read incoming RFQs, purchase orders and supplier documents, draft quotes and enter orders for your team to approve — built around your ERP.
- [AI Quoting for Machine Shops and Fabricators](https://visionzlab.com/for/machine-shops/): AI that reads RFQs, drawings, sketches and 3D models, asks the buyer what's missing and drafts the quote for your estimator to approve.
- [AI Automation for P&C Insurance Brokers](https://visionzlab.com/for/insurance-brokers/): AI agents for commercial and property & casualty brokerages and MGAs: submission intake, certificates, renewals and claims intake, with brokers in control.
- [AI Bookkeeping Automation for Accounting Firms](https://visionzlab.com/for/accountants-bookkeepers/): An AI employee that handles routine bookkeeping tasks for accounting and bookkeeping practices — or training so your team can build it themselves.
- [AI for Small Business](https://visionzlab.com/for/small-business/): Practical AI for owner-run businesses: learn to build your own agents, get one set up with you, or have us build and run one.
- [AI Automation for Mortgage Brokers and Agents](https://visionzlab.com/for/mortgage-brokers/): AI tools for mortgage brokerages and agents: renewal tracking and outreach, document collection, lead follow-up and AI search visibility, in several languages.
